chinese_source: Yijing, Nanhai jigui neifa zhuan, grammar chapter (sent to China 691)
event: Yijing names Bhartrhari's works, makes him a contemporary of Dharmapala, and states 'it is forty years since his death' - implying death c. 651-652 CE
firmness_reason: Firm as a record of what Yijing reports; Probable as history (Frauwallner-line pushback and the two-Bhartrhari escape hatch are documented in the spine)
notes: Campaign case 7 (calibration): verdict CORRECTED. Muller: 'a new sheet-anchor in the chronology of Sanskrit literature.' Cf. spine C26.
